UPDATE kanban_tasks SET
            title = CASE WHEN $1 = '' THEN title ELSE NULLIF($2, '')::text END,
            body = CASE WHEN $3 = $4 THEN body ELSE $5 END,
            assignee = CASE WHEN $6 = '' THEN assignee ELSE NULLIF($7, '')::text END,
            channel_id = CASE WHEN $8 = -999999::bigint THEN channel_id ELSE $9 END,
            profile = CASE WHEN $10 = '' THEN profile ELSE NULLIF($11, '')::text END,
            priority = CASE WHEN $12 = -999999::bigint THEN priority::bigint ELSE $13 END,
            status = CASE WHEN $14 = '' THEN status ELSE $15 END,
            archived = $16,
            template = CASE WHEN $17 = '' THEN template ELSE NULLIF($18, '')::text END,
            plan = $19,
            planning_mode = CASE WHEN $20 = '' THEN planning_mode ELSE NULLIF($21, '')::text END,
            workflow_id = CASE WHEN $22 = '' THEN workflow_id ELSE NULLIF($23, '')::text END,
            updated_at = NOW()
        WHERE id = $24
